title: Fragments on Romans
blurb: Cyril of Alexandria's surviving comments on Paul's Letter to the Romans, in a fresh English translation from the Greek. He explains the law and grace, Adam and Christ, baptism, the flesh and the Spirit, and God's mercy to Israel and to the nations.
scope: The surviving fragments of Cyril's commentary on Romans, as printed in PG 74, on Romans 1 to 15. Many fragments begin or end mid-sentence.
first_english_note: A fresh English translation made from the Greek text printed in PG 74. No published English version was used for its wording.
